name: Ningbo Exciton Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Exciton Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of optical films and functional films in China. The company operates through four segments: Optoelectronics, Photovoltaics, Automobile, and Batteries. The Optoelectronics segment offers optical film products, including diffusion films, brightness enhancement films, quantum dot films, COP films, and composite films, DOP, POP, DPP, silver reflective film, 3D film, protective film, mobile phone hardening film, etc. The Photovoltaic segment provides double-sided coating, coating composite, single-sided coating, transparent back panel, and gap reflective film.
